## Notes for Test Extraction

- **BIO 101**: 8 laboratory reports, 3 quizzes, 2 major exams, 1 research paper with outline and final submission. Term is Fall 2026, starts 2026-09-14.
- **HIST 210**: Mix of explicit dates (essay due Friday) and relative dates (weekly schedule). Term starts 2026-09-01. Final paper is the culminating assignment. Some items (e.g., participation) span the whole term with no specific due date.
- **CALC 150**: Dense assessment schedule with 10 problem sets, 5 quizzes, 2 major exams. Point-based rather than percentage-based. Includes attendance/participation component (50 pts) awarded after final exam. Homework Notebooks due before Thanksgiving break (2026-11-24).
